author: DamiLee
description: Bag End isn’t just a hobbit hole, it’s a country estate disguised as simplicity. From handcrafted woodwork to its impractical but symbolic round design, Bilbo’s home reflects quiet wealth, skilled labor, and the luxury of time and land. Is cottagecore really about simplicity, or comfort elevated to status?
title: So... Bilbo was kinda Bougie
